008package paint.shared.constants;
009
010/**
011 * Defines geometric constants used for spatial calculations and image rendering within the
012 * PAINT application.
013 * <p>
014 * The {@code PaintGeometry} class centralizes constants related to pixel dimensions, grid
015 * scaling, and coordinate systems.
016 * </p>
017 */
018public final class PaintGeometry {
019
020    private PaintGeometry() {
021        // Prevent instantiation
022    }
023
024    /** Pixel width in µm (specified by Nikon). */
025    public static final double PIXEL_WIDTH          = 0.1603251;
026    /** Pixel height in µm (specified by Nikon). */
027    public static final double PIXEL_HEIGHT         = 0.1603251;
028    /** Number of pixels in image width (specified by Nikon). */
029    public static final int    NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH  = 512;
030    /** Number of pixels in image height (specified by Nikon). */
031    public static final int    NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT = 512;
032    /** Total image width in µm. */
033    public static final double IMAGE_WIDTH          = PIXEL_WIDTH * NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH;
034    /** Total image height in µm. */
035    public static final double IMAGE_HEIGHT         = PIXEL_HEIGHT * NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT;
036}
